Intel On Demand feature licensing
Intel On Demand is a licensing ofefring from Lenovo for certain 4th Gen and 5th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable
processors that implements software-defni ed silicon (SDSi) features. The licenses allow customers to
activate the embedded accelerators and to increase the SGX Enclave size in specifci processor models as
their workload and business needs change.
The available upgrades are the following:
Up to 4x QuickAssist Technology (Intel QAT) accelerators
Up to 4x Intel Dynamic Load Balancer (Intel DLB) accelerators
Up to 4x Intel Data Streaming Accelerator (Intel DSA) accelerators
Up to 4x Intel In-Memory Analytics Accelerator (Intel IAA) accelerators
512GB SGX Enclave, an encrypted memory space for use by Intel Software Guard Extensions (SGX)
See the Processor features section for a brief description of each accelerator and the SGX Enclave.

Intel On Demand is licensed on individual processors. For servers with two processors, customers will need
a license for each processor and the licenses of the two processors must match. If customers add a second
